timing: Fixed after source-only inference pilot and before contextualized real-data clustering. Previous state-only clustering, six fixed context cases, and development contextual retrieval implementation are known; not independent registration.

clustering.selection: Maximum source-training silhouette, smaller K on ties within 1e-12; never query/test selection.

variants: All six neural conditions with context, all three model seeds and 15 folds; statistics without/with context and context-only once per fold. Existing neural no-context patterns remain unchanged as references.
limits: Patterns remain unnamed, source-fitted descriptions, not tactical duties or semantic validation.
Neural-seed ARI uses only common accepted queries with at least two represented clusters per comparison; report missing counts.
Deterministic controls have no neural-seed ARI, not an ARI of zero.
Source-series bootstrap holds encoder, context normalization and K fixed; not full-pipeline uncertainty.
Coverage counts are query-seed assignments, not independent observations; old no-context source/test results are preserved.
No selection of weight or architecture by new test clustering results.
